title: Glossary
description: plugin/glossary/terms.yaml (the plugin's terms) and evals/glossary.yaml (a repo's own terms). The explainer's only source of words: the dashboard, the CLI and the PR comment all read it. docs/EXPLAINER.md is the contract; litmustest validate enforces the rules beyond shape.

term.description: The term as people read it.

aliases.description: Other spellings the product or people use. Unique across all terms.

short.description: Layer 1: what it means, in 20 words or fewer. Another term is linked as [[id]].

why.description: Why it matters, in one sentence.

good.description: What good looks like. The only place a template's fixed numbers may come from.

here.description: Layer 2: what it means here. One {source, template} object, or a list of them tried in order when a term is explained from more than one place or state.

learn_more.description: The Master Class chapter with the long form.

next.description: Next steps; the first whose when holds is shown. The last has no when.

when.description: A condition over the source's facts. The last step has none, so it always matches.

action.description: A dashboard command id (pending.commit, judges.runTest, review.openBatch…), or several; the first is the primary button. Where a command is available on the current screen, the panel renders it as a button that runs the page's own handler.

link.description: A dashboard route such as #/judges/{judge}, for when the step is done elsewhere.

source.description: The read model the template prints from; docs/EXPLAINER.md lists the files behind each.

when.description: A condition over the source's facts; variants are tried in order.

next.description: Next steps for this variant; overrides the entry's next.
